hero.title: Our editors' pick for your move-in WiFi
hero.subtitle: After testing every plan for a no-contract, self-install move, our team keeps coming back to one clear winner, plus a few standouts for special situations.
choice.title: Xfinity Gig Internet
choice.quote: It is the rare plan that is fast enough to future-proof your apartment yet flexible enough to walk away from anytime. For movers, nothing else comes close.
choice.byline: Reviewed by the Xfinity Home Networking team
choice.rationale: Gig-speed, fiber-powered WiFi with the xFi Gateway built in means you unbox, self-install in minutes, and are streaming in 4K on move-in day. It handles dozens of devices without a stutter, and there is no contract holding you hostage if your needs change.
choice.points: Up to 1 Gig download speeds with unlimited data
xFi Gateway and whole-home WiFi included
Peacock Premium on us for 2 years
situational.title: Also great for...
item-1.title: Xfinity Internet 300 Mbps
item-1.body: Our best-value starter plan. Reliable, everyday WiFi with same-day self-install and a free Xfinity Mobile line for a year.
item-2.title: Xfinity Internet 500 Mbps
item-2.body: Fast, consistent WiFi that keeps up with every device at once, even at peak hours, with no annual contract.
item-3.title: Xfinity Mobile - Mobile Select
item-3.body: Unlimited talk, text, and data on the most reliable 5G network. Add a line free for a year with any Internet plan.
note.label: The editors' bottom line
note.title: Why we would set it up this way
note.body: Start with Gig Internet for headroom you will not outgrow, then add the free mobile line to trim your monthly total. If your place is small or your budget is tight, the 300 Mbps plan is a genuinely great fallback that we would happily recommend to family.
cta.title: Go with the editors' pick
cta.body: Order Gig Internet today, self-install in minutes, and add a free mobile line whenever you are ready.
